BiblicalUsage: The word is thirty, in Aramaic. The presidents and princes ask Darius to establish a royal statute for thirty days, that no one shall ask a petition of any god or man save the king; and they remind the king of the decree of thirty days.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe thirty days was all the trap needed, and Daniel's prayer outlasted it.
